item: Climate fetchers: the body read stops at its derived bound and sessions are pinned to their directories
status: shipped (fixtures only; not verified against live hosts)
refs: R496 R572; v0.6.0 plan A1 hardening PR #1803
summary: guarded_session gains allowed_path_prefixes (checked beside allowed_hosts on the first request and every redirect hop; dot segments, percent escapes and backslashes are refused, not normalised), so raw.githubusercontent.com is pinned to the owid repositories instead of to every repository on the host. The GISTEMP, OWID and USGS getters read the body in chunks and abandon it when it passes the bound the table's own shape derives (four bytes per character, or a longer declared Content-Length), instead of downloading it all and measuring after; USGS reads its count under a small bound and its events under the bound the count fixed. Named limit: the timeout bounds each read, not the whole transfer. The other fetchers in the module keep the unbounded default getter.
